topics.text: Rooms have 270° floor-to-ceiling windows with mountain and bamboo views. Facilities are new and complete, offering a comfortable stay. Breakfast is home-style, and there is an evening cocktail.

Pet-friendly with a resident cat, and facilities like a small net and umbrella prepared for stream activities, suitable for pets. Dinner can be pre-ordered, with delicious dishes like bamboo shoot soup and braised pork. There is an outdoor pool for relaxation.

address: No. 37, Yu Village, Fatou Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: Lovely stay in this family managed hotel. Location, room, and food were simply great. We will surely come back
